title: A goal that says every or whatever is tested over its input range
goal: The kb-worker brief, the kb-backlog skill and kb/_self/backlog.md say that an item whose goal claims a property for every input or whatever input (every item, whatever number of commits) proves it with a test over a range of inputs, including sizes and steps that share a factor or change between runs, not one case its author chose; a cohesion test holds the wording. Answers SP-5cwekumc's retrospective: ST-xq3ghjhb's check advanced one commit per run and passed while the review showed the rotation never reaches some items (BG-3q6fviow).
